name: CIFAR-10
description: CIFAR-10 is a dataset of 60,000 32x32 color images divided into 10 classes, with 50,000 training images and 10,000 validation images. The paper introduces fast training methods (airbench94, airbench95, airbench96) that achieve 94%, 95%, and 96% accuracy respectively on this dataset.
creator: Alex Krizhevsky, Vinod Nair, Geoffrey Hinton
rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation. The paper develops training methods to accelerate research and reduce experimental costs. The methods can be used to accelerate experimental iteration time for researchers working on compatible projects involving CIFAR-10, decrease the cost of projects involving massive numbers of trained networks, and enable rapid accumulation of statistical significance for subtle hyperparameter comparisons.
